messages.subject: It worked
messages.body:
I logged in this morning.

My messages were there. Only mine. She checked hers too. Support sent us separate confirmation numbers.

I finally answered the note from the library. It had been sitting there all week.

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body:
I turned the reminders back on. The first one was for an appointment I’d forgotten I’d made.

The other Mira and I still have each other’s number. We said we’d leave it at that for now. Please tell Support both cases can close.

messages.subject: Local recovery closed
messages.body:
Both confirmations are back. I’ve closed the two Support cases.

The outbox has a receipt for each account. Those can go on the gateway’s regular archival run.
